messages:
maya: Quick poll 1 — validation patterns for Console > Model Pins. three options: inline-only, summary+anchors, summary-only. required marker: * vs (required). delete confirm: modal vs typed confirm. pasted two tiny artboards. dan: Need mobile behavior and a11y checklist. Can you paste the screens? maya: pasted. TL;DR: inline-only = minimal; summary+anchors = best for keyboard/screen-reader; summary-only = compact. sophia: +1 for summary+inline. Make the summary an alert region (role="alert" aria-live="assertive") and move focus to it on submit. anchor links should focus the input. oliver: prefer explicit "(required)" copy not color-only asterisk. keep inline hints for context after user returns to a field. marco: typed confirm for irreversible deletes or bulk deletes (>10 items). otherwise modal + checkbox is fine. require admin role for bulk actions. dan: a11y checklist: set aria-invalid="true" on invalid fields, link errors with aria-describedby, focus summary on desktop; on mobile scroll to first inline error because summary can be off-screen. a11y-bot: WCAG reminder: do not rely on color alone to indicate required state. ensure error outlines meet 3:1 contrast for UI components. sophia: UX note: if there are more than 3 errors expand the summary by default and tone down inline noise. anchors can collapse/expand their related inline hints. maya: copy tweak: header = "Please fix these fields to continue" (less scary). typed confirm copy: "Type DELETE to permanently remove this model pin." keep it brief. oliver: interaction detail: clicking a summary item should call focus() on the input (not just label). include data-error-id for telemetry. maya: small snippet I'll include in the spec: ```html

Please fix these fields to continue

  • Model name is required
  • Pin count must be a number
``` maya: consensus: adopt summary+inline anchors, explicit "(required)", typed confirms for irreversible/bulk deletes, focus summary on desktop, scroll-to-first-inline on mobile, and follow WCAG contrast/aria rules. I'll update Figma + post the spec in ~20m. :thumbsup:
